meta.name: Genius
meta.description:
The life stories of history's greatest minds. From their days as young adults to their final years we see their discoveries, loves, relationships, causes, flaws and genius.

Rated TV-14 · Canceled · First aired 25 Apr 2017 · United States of America · Language: English · 43 min
Studio: EUE / Sokolow Entertainment, Imagine Television Studios, OddLot Entertainment · Network: National Geographic

Not complete. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 10/10 | S3 8/8 | S4 not on server

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Chapter One
videos.overview: The story of Albert Einstein, seen through glimpses of his twilight years and flashbacks to his time as a student in Munich and Zürich in the 1890s.

videos.title: Chapter Two
videos.overview: After butting heads in class, Einstein falls in love with the determined Mileva Maric. Their affair raises eyebrows.

videos.title: Chapter Three
videos.overview: Einstein struggles to support his pregnant wife and land an academic post in a rigid world of tradition and protocol.

videos.title: Chapter Four
videos.overview: Albert Einstein and Mileva juggle raising a kids with his attempts to catch the eye of the scientific establishment.

videos.title: Chapter Five
videos.overview: Einstein begins to experience the academic life he coveted, but he falters in his familial responsibilities. He is reintroduced to his cousin Elsa.

videos.title: Chapter Six
videos.overview: Einstein moves his family for work, and to be closer to his new love, Elsa. He sets out to prove his theory as his marriage reaches a breaking point.

videos.title: Chapter Seven
videos.overview: In the wake of the war, patriotism corrupts one of Albert Einstein’s closest friends, Fritz Haber, pitting them against each other.

videos.title: Chapter Eight
videos.overview: Einstein and his wife Elsa attempt to flee Germany after the rise of the Nazis, but they face unexpected roadblocks.

videos.title: Chapter Nine
videos.overview: Albert Einstein settles into life in America, but dangers abroad continue to be a threat to both him and his former colleagues.

videos.title: Chapter Ten
videos.overview: After the atomic bomb is dropped and World War II draws to a close, Einstein assumes the role of world citizen in his twilight years.

videos.title: Chapter One
videos.overview: Pablo Picasso confronts the threat of fascism in Spain, and Young Pablo rejects traditional painting to search for his own voice.

videos.title: Chapter Two
videos.overview: Picasso's relationship with Dora Maar is strained by war. Young Pablo succeeds by imitating the masters, but struggles to be original.

videos.title: Chapter Three
videos.overview: Picasso meets his great love Franoise Gilot. Young Pablo begins his Blue Period after the suicide of his friend.

videos.title: Chapter Four
videos.overview: As older Picasso juggles two love affairs, Young Pablo strives to create a masterpiece that will signal his arrival as a great artist.

videos.title: Chapter Five
videos.overview: Picasso tries to convince Françoise to move in with him, while Young Pablo is challenged by the radical genius of Matisse.

videos.title: Chapter Six
videos.overview: Picasso takes Françoise Gilot on vacation. Young Pablo starts cubism with Georges Braque, but is accused of stealing the Mona Lisa.

videos.title: Chapter Seven
videos.overview: After WWII, Picasso joins the Communist Party but struggles to align his artwork with his own political beliefs. Affected by a tragic love affair from his past, Picasso falters in his responsibilities to Françoise.

videos.title: Chapter Eight
videos.overview: Pablo meets his first wife, a ballerina, while designing a ballet. Older Picasso struggles to manage his complex family.

videos.title: Chapter Nine
videos.overview: Younger Picasso finds respite from his strained marriage with Olga in the arms of his newest muse: Marie-Thérèse Walter. However, their romance is short-lived, cause soon he crosses paths with Dora Maar. Meanwhile, Françoise Gilot defies Older Picasso and pursues her artistic goals.

videos.title: Chapter Ten
videos.overview: After Françoise Gilot leaves him, Pablo finds companionship with a new woman. In near seclusion, Pablo obsesses over creating the perfect painting. Meanwhile, Françoise struggles to escape Picasso's shadow even after remarrying and moving to the US.

videos.title: Respect
videos.overview: Desperate for a hit, Aretha travels to Muscle Shoals in 1967 to record her first album with Atlantic Records. After suffering the loss of her surrogate mother, Little Re braves her first solo in 1953, in her father’s, C.L. Franklin, church.

videos.title: Until the Real Thing Comes Along
videos.overview: Struggling to find her sound, Aretha catches the attention of Jerry Wexler at Atlantic Records in 1966. Meanwhile, Little Re has her first touring experience on the Gospel Circuit in 1954 with C.L. Franklin and meets her idol, Clara Ward.

videos.title: Do Right Woman
videos.overview: Aretha juggles her music career and her commitment to the civil rights movement, led by Martin Luther King Jr., in 1967 and 1968. Meanwhile, Little Re leaves behind her newborn child to return to the Gospel Circuit in 1955, meeting with music legends James Cleveland and Little Sammie Bryant.

videos.title: Unforgettable
videos.overview: Aretha is featured on the cover of Time Magazine in 1968, but she’s devastated when the article focuses on the scandalous details of her personal life. Barbara Franklin and Young C.L. Franklin struggle to establish themselves in Memphis in 1941, before Little Re is born.

videos.title: Young, Gifted and Black
videos.overview: Aretha, inspired by Angela Davis and the Soledad Brothers, records her protest album “Young, Gifted and Black” in 1970. Despite Jerry Wexler’s uncertainty, the album is a success. Barbara Franklin makes a decision that has a devastating effect on Little Re in 1951.

videos.title: Amazing Grace
videos.overview: Aretha records her best-selling live Gospel album “Amazing Grace” in 1972 at New Temple Missionary Baptist Church, ignoring her sibling’s pleas to record instead at New Bethel with their father, C.L. Franklin.

videos.title: Chain of Fools
videos.overview: As the Queen of Soul enters the age of disco, Aretha will do anything to remain relevant—including stealing an opportunity from her sister Carolyn. She receives a GRAMMY nomination but is ultimately snubbed from winning the award.

videos.title: No One Sleeps
videos.overview: Despite significant emotional losses, including a second divorce and the death of her father in 1984, Aretha pushes herself artistically and triumphs.

meta.slogan: Martin Luther King Jr / Malcolm X. Two minds, one movement.
